target.source_note: Working-tree assets at capture; HEAD is only the parent checkpoint. No live gateway/provider or production proof.

honesty.access: Existing hermetic auth/API fixture only. No real credentials, membership, gateway or model request; synthetic quote evidence is fixture text.
honesty.gaps: states that were not captured are recorded with a reason; nothing is inferred for them
honesty.authority: this tool measures and screenshots; it scores, ranks, and judges nothing
honesty.force_states: a forced state is either a class/attribute toggled on <body> or a real browser hover/focus applied to a selector before the shot; it shows that state's presentation, not data the page returned; metrics are measured on the rest cells only, and a state that did not take is recorded as a gap
honesty.data: AAPL statement is a fixed public snapshot. Other prices, company metrics and transcript content are explicitly illustrative.
honesty.metrics: Request/payload observations begin after fixture bootstrap; timing is unmeasured. Viewport captures show real chat composition; statement-lower shows the message scroll bottom.
